title: Docker: Get started
content: Learn images, containers, Dockerfiles and Compose. Practice packaging a small application; demonstrate the work before adding Docker to your resume.

title: Python tutorial
content: Study Python control flow, functions, modules and exceptions. Write a small tested command-line application.

title: FastAPI tutorial
content: Build endpoints with request validation and response models. Document and test a small REST API.

title: Flask tutorial
content: Create a small Flask application with persistence and tests.

title: GitHub Actions documentation
content: Learn automated workflows and continuous integration. Add linting and tests to an existing project. Hosted runner usage has limits; read the billing terms before running workflows.

title: AWS documentation
content: Read cloud architecture and IAM concepts for free. AWS service usage can cost money; this recommendation does not require creating or deploying paid resources.

title: PostgreSQL tutorial
content: Practice queries, joins, transactions and schema design in a local PostgreSQL database.

title: React: Learn
content: Build an accessible interface using components, state and events. Use a local development server.

title: pytest documentation
content: Write assertions, fixtures and parameterized tests for a small Python project.

title: scikit-learn user guide
content: Practice train/test splits, pipelines and model evaluation. Avoid data leakage and document evaluation limitations.

title: MDN: Learn web development
content: Build accessible web pages, learn JavaScript and understand HTTP requests. Demonstrate skills in a working portfolio project.

title: Kubernetes basics
content: Learn deployments, services and scaling. Use a local cluster to avoid cloud hosting costs.

title: Pro Git book
content: Practice commits, branches, merges and collaboration in a local repository.

title: pandas getting started
content: Load, clean and summarize tabular data. Build a reproducible analysis with a public or synthetic dataset.
